title: Xbox Made an Alligator-Shaped Series X to Celebrate GTA 6
description: Xbox has revealed a one-of-a-kind alligator-shaped Series X console to celebrate the upcoming launch of GTA 6, and players can win it before release.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Xbox Reveals Alligator-Shaped Series X Ahead of GTA 6 Launch

With GTA 6 just weeks away from its anticipated launch, excitement across the gaming community is reaching a fever pitch. Joining in on the celebration, Xbox has unveiled a truly unique, one-of-a-kind piece of hardware that brings a piece of the game's setting directly into players' living rooms.

### Bringing Leonida Wildlife to Hardware

According to reports from IGN, Xbox has created an alligator-shaped Series X console to mark the impending release of Rockstar's next blockbuster. Drawing inspiration from the wildlife of Leonida—the fictional region where GTA 6 is set—this custom console offers a striking visual tribute to the local ecosystem featured in the game.

As the final weeks before release tick down, official marketing and special community activations are ramping up. This custom console stands out as a memorable piece of hardware that captures the spirit of the upcoming open-world adventure.

### Win It Before Release

Players looking to get their hands on this rare collectible will have the chance to win it before GTA 6 officially launches. While specific rules and entry details for the giveaway are rolling out, the prospect of owning a custom alligator-themed Series X is sure to catch the attention of hardware enthusiasts and die-hard fans alike.

## Editor's Take

Xbox's custom alligator Series X is a brilliant and fun way to celebrate the arrival of GTA 6. Tying the hardware design directly into the wildlife of Leonida shows great creativity, giving lucky fans a chance to own a piece of gaming history right before stepping into the new open world.
